beginner.name: Chest Press Machine
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — 3s controlled return, 1s chest contraction, smooth press.
steps: Adjust the seat height so the handles align with your mid-chest.
Plant feet flat on the floor and press your shoulder blades firmly into the pad.
Grip handles and exhale as you press forward without locking elbows.
Inhale and slowly lower the weight over 3 seconds until a comfortable chest stretch is felt.
commonMistakes: Allowing elbows to flare higher than shoulder level.
Arching lower back off the pad.
Letting weight stack slam between repetitions.

machine.name: Selectorized Chest Press Machine (Life Fitness / Matrix)
machine.setupGuide: Set seat pin to hole #3-#5 so handles match mid-sternum. Pin load to 20kg.

alternatives.name: Pec Fly Machine
alternatives.swapReason: Isolates chest adduction without shoulder strain

beginner.name: Pec Deck / Butterfly Machine
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-2-0 — Feel deep chest stretch, squeeze chest hard at peak.
steps: Adjust seat so pads rest against your forearms with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Press elbows together smoothly in an arc motion.
Hold contraction for 1 second at the center.
Control the return slowly over 3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Letting elbows drop below 90 degrees.
Shrugging shoulders upward during contraction.

machine.name: Pec Deck Fly Machine (Hammer Strength Select)
machine.setupGuide: Seat height adjusted so arm pads match shoulder height.

beginner.name: Incline Push-Up (Bench Support)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Keep rigid plank line from head to heels.
steps: Place hands on a standard flat gym bench slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Step feet back until your body forms a straight diagonal plank line.
Lower chest toward the bench by bending elbows to 45 degrees.
Push firmly through your palms to return to starting position.
commonMistakes: Sagging hips or piking glutes into the air.
Dropping head forward before chest touches.

machine.name: Standard Flat Utility Bench
machine.setupGuide: Ensure bench is placed flat and stable on rubber flooring.

alternatives.name: Smith Machine Push-Up
alternatives.swapReason: Adjustable bar height to customize resistance

beginner.name: Flat Dumbbell Press (Light)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Balanced independent arm control.
steps: Sit on flat bench with dumbbells resting on thighs.
Lie back, bringing dumbbells to sides of chest with palms facing forward.
Press weights directly upward over chest without clanking them together.
Lower dumbbells with control until upper arms are parallel to floor.
commonMistakes: Bouncing weights at the bottom.
Flaring elbows out perpendicular to torso.

machine.name: Flat Workout Bench & Polyurethane Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Position bench clear of rack aisles. Select light matching dumbbells.

beginner.name: Standing Cable Chest Fly (Mid Pulley)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-0-1-1 — Gentle hug motion with elbows softly rounded.
steps: Set pulleys to chest height. Grab D-handles and take one step forward into a split stance.
Maintain a slight forward torso lean and soft bend in your elbows.
Bring hands forward in a wide hugging arc until knuckles nearly touch.
Open arms back slowly under steady cable tension.
commonMistakes: Using momentum or swinging the torso.
Locking elbows rigid.

machine.name: Dual Adjustable Cable Column
machine.setupGuide: Set dual pulleys to notch #8 (chest height). Attach single D-handles.

beginner.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Pull with elbows down, not with your hands.
steps: Sit on seat and adjust thigh pad so knees are securely wedged.
Grasp wide lat bar with overhand grip just outside shoulder width.
Lean torso back 10-15 degrees, pull bar down smoothly to upper chest.
Control bar on the way up until arms are fully extended and lats stretched.
commonMistakes: Pulling bar behind the neck.
Leaning excessively backward like a row.

machine.name: Selectorized Lat Pulldown Machine
machine.setupGuide: Adjust roller pad firmly over thighs. Connect 48-inch lat bar.

beginner.name: Seated Cable Row (Neutral Grip)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Squeeze shoulder blades together, upright torso.
steps: Sit on machine, place feet on footrests with knees slightly bent.
Grip V-handle attachment with arms extended and back straight.
Pull handle toward lower abdomen while pulling shoulders back and down.
Slowly extend arms back to start without rounding the spine.
commonMistakes: Rocking torso back and forth excessively.
Rounding lower back during extension.

machine.name: Low Row Cable Bench
machine.setupGuide: Clip V-bar attachment to low pulley carabiner.

beginner.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Chest pinned firmly against the pad.
steps: Adjust chest pad so handles are at arm’s reach.
Plant feet firmly and keep sternum glued to the chest cushion.
Pull handles back until elbows pass your torso line.
Pause for 1 second, then extend arms with full control.
commonMistakes: Lifting chest off the pad to heave the weight.
Only pulling with biceps instead of retracting scapulae.

machine.name: Iso-Lateral Chest-Supported Row
machine.setupGuide: Seat and chest pad adjusted to mid-torso height.

beginner.name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — High counterweight allows strict bodyweight form.
steps: Set the counterbalance pin (heavier pin = easier assistance).
Place knees securely on the padded carriage and grasp wide handles.
Pull body upward until chin easily clears the bar level.
Lower yourself smoothly until arms are fully stretched.
commonMistakes: Stepping off before carriage is fully stationary.
Kicking legs or swinging on the pad.

machine.name: Counterbalance Assisted Dip & Chin Station
machine.setupGuide: Pull knee rest pad down into operating position.

beginner.name: Back Hyperextension (45-Degree Bench)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Hinge at hips, avoid hyperextending neck.
steps: Position yourself face down with hips resting on upper pads and ankles locked.
Cross arms over chest or place hands gently beside ears.
Hinge forward from the hips until torso is roughly perpendicular to legs.
Engage glutes and spinal erectors to raise torso in a straight line with legs.
commonMistakes: Overarching backwards beyond a straight neutral spine.
Jerking torso upward quickly.

machine.name: 45-Degree Hyperextension Roman Chair
machine.setupGuide: Set pelvic pad just below hip crease to allow unrestricted hip flexion.

beginner.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Full back support, elbows slightly forward in scapular plane.
steps: Sit on a 90-degree upright bench with back pressed firmly into the backrest.
Hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward or slightly angled.
Press weights straight up overhead until arms are nearly extended.
Lower with control over 3 seconds back to ear level.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back off the backrest.
Clanking dumbbells together at the top.

machine.name: 90-Degree Upright Utility Bench & Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Pin backrest to 85°-90° upright position.

beginner.name: Standing Dumbbell Lateral Raise
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Lead with elbows, pour from a pitcher motion.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Slight bend in elbows. Raise dumbbells outward and upward until parallel to floor.
Hold for a split-second feeling the lateral deltoid burn.
Lower smoothly back to starting position.
commonMistakes: Swinging hips or using momentum.
Lifting higher than shoulder level.

machine.name: Dumbbell Free Weight Area
machine.setupGuide: Select light pair to preserve strict deltoid isolation.

beginner.name: Machine Shoulder Press
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-0-1-0 — Guided overhead vertical press path.
steps: Adjust seat so handles start at ear height.
Sit with back flat against the pad and grasp handles.
Exhale as you press upward into full extension without hyperextending elbows.
Inhale while lowering handles smoothly to ear height.
commonMistakes: Dropping seat too low putting rotator cuff under excessive strain.
Shrugging traps excessively.

machine.name: Overhead Shoulder Press Machine
machine.setupGuide: Seat height notch #4. Neutral or pronated grip handles.

beginner.name: Cable Face Pull (Rope Attachment)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-1 — Pull rope to forehead, rotate hands outward.
steps: Attach rope attachment to cable pulley set at eye level.
Grip rope ends with thumbs pointing backward and step into split stance.
Pull rope directly toward eye level while driving elbows high and wide.
External rotate hands back at end range, pause 1s, then slowly extend.
commonMistakes: Pulling down to chest instead of face.
Dropping elbows below wrist level.

machine.name: Adjustable Cable Column & Braided Rope
machine.setupGuide: Set pulley to eye height (hole #9).

beginner.name: Dumbbell Front Raise (Alternating)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-0-1-0 — Smooth alternating front delt raise.
steps: Hold dumbbells resting on the front of your thighs.
Raise one dumbbell straight forward to shoulder height with palm down.
Pause briefly at horizontal level, then lower under control.
Alternate with the opposite arm in rhythm.
commonMistakes: Leaning back as weight rises.
Swinging torso.

machine.name: Free Weight Dumbbell Rack
machine.setupGuide: Clear 2-meter standing perimeter.

alternatives.name: Cable Front Raise with Straight Bar

beginner.name: Leg Press (45-Degree Incline)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Knees track over toes, do not lock knees at lockout.
steps: Sit firmly in the leg press seat with lower back and hips pressed against pad.
Place feet hip-width apart in the center of the footplate.
Release safety handles and lower weight slowly until knees bend to 90 degrees.
Press smoothly through heels to return, keeping soft bend in knees at top.
commonMistakes: Allowing lower back to curl off the seat pad.
Hyperextending and violently locking knee joints at the top.

machine.name: 45-Degree Plate-Loaded Leg Press
machine.setupGuide: Check safety catch handles. Seat angle set to notch #3.

beginner.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell or Kettlebell)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Keep weight tight against sternum, elbows inside knees.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes angled slightly out.
Hold dumbbell vertically against chest with palms supporting the upper head.
Sit hips back and down between heels, keeping chest proudly upright.
Drive through whole foot to stand back up to starting position.
commonMistakes: Letting chest collapse forward.
Knees caving inward during ascent.

machine.name: Dumbbell / Kettlebell Stand
machine.setupGuide: Select single 8kg or 12kg dumbbell/kettlebell.

beginner.name: Seated Leg Extension (Quads)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Controlled quad extension with 1s squeeze at top.
steps: Sit with back against backrest, knee joint aligned with machine pivot axis.
Ankle pad should rest comfortably on lower shins just above ankles.
Extend legs forward and upward until knees are fully extended.
Squeeze quadriceps for 1s, then lower slowly over 2-3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Kicking weight up with momentum.
Letting hips rise up off the seat.

machine.name: Selectorized Leg Extension Machine
machine.setupGuide: Align knee joint precisely with rotation pivot indicator.

beginner.name: Lying or Seated Leg Curl (Hamstrings)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-3-0 — Smooth hamstring contraction, slow 3s eccentric.
steps: Lie face down with Achilles tendons tucked under the lower leg roller pad.
Grip side handles and keep hips pressed down firmly against the bench.
Curl roller up toward your glutes by bending knees.
Hold contraction for 1 second, then lower back slowly.
commonMistakes: Lifting hips off bench during contraction.
Lowering weight quickly without resistance.

machine.name: Prone Lying Leg Curl Machine
machine.setupGuide: Adjust ankle roller so it sits below calves on Achilles tendon.

alternatives.name: Seated Leg Curl
alternatives.swapReason: More comfortable position for lower back

beginner.name: Standing Calf Raise on Step
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-1 — Deep calf stretch at bottom, high extension on balls of feet.
steps: Stand with balls of feet on an elevated aerobic step or calf block, holding a railing for balance.
Lower heels down below step level until you feel a deep stretch in calves.
Press up powerfully onto the balls of both feet as high as possible.
Pause at peak for 1 second before lowering.
commonMistakes: Bouncing rapidly without pausing.
Bending knees to generate momentum.

machine.name: Standing Calf Block / Aerobic Riser
machine.gymZone: Zone A / Zone E • Free Weights
machine.setupGuide: Place sturdy block near wall or handrail.

beginner.name: Standing Dumbbell Bicep Curl
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Pin elbows against ribs, rotate wrists outward as you curl.
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells hanging at arm’s length, palms facing inward.
Keep upper arms stationary and curl weights upward while supinating wrists.
Squeeze biceps firmly at shoulder height.
Lower dumbbells with control back to starting neutral position.
commonMistakes: Swinging torso to get weights up.
Moving elbows forward to reduce bicep tension.

machine.name: Dumbbell Free Weight Area
machine.setupGuide: Select matching dumbbell pair.

alternatives.name: Cable Bicep Curl with EZ Bar

beginner.name: Cable Tricep Rope Pushdown
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Spread rope ends apart at the bottom for tricep lock.
steps: Attach rope attachment to high cable pulley.
Hold rope ends with elbows pinned tight against your sides.
Push hands down toward thighs, spreading ends of the rope outward at the bottom.
Squeeze triceps for 1s, then return hands slowly to chest level.
commonMistakes: Allowing elbows to flare forward or drift upward.
Leaning entire bodyweight over the rope.

machine.name: High Pulley Cable Column
machine.setupGuide: Pulley pin set to top position (notch #12).

alternatives.name: Straight Bar Cable Pushdown
alternatives.swapReason: Heavier load capacity with fixed grip

beginner.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl (Neutral Grip)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-0-2-0 — Palms face each other throughout to target brachialis.
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides with neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Keep elbows stationary beside torso and curl dumbbells upward.
Pause at top for 1 second squeezing forearms and brachialis.
Lower weights slowly under complete muscular control.
commonMistakes: Swinging weights using shoulder flexion.
Letting wrists bend backwards.

machine.name: Dumbbell Free Weight Area
machine.setupGuide: Dumbbells ready at side.

beginner.name: Bench Tricep Dips (Feet on Floor)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Keep back close to bench, bend elbows to 90 degrees.
steps: Sit on edge of a flat bench with hands next to hips gripping edge.
Extend legs forward with knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on floor.
Slide glutes off bench and lower hips by bending elbows to 90 degrees.
Press through palms to push back up to starting lockout.
commonMistakes: Drifting hips too far away from bench putting excessive torque on shoulders.
Shrugging shoulders up toward ears.

machine.name: Flat Utility Gym Bench
machine.setupGuide: Position bench securely on level rubber matting.

alternatives.name: Assisted Dip Machine
alternatives.swapReason: Allows full range dip motion with counterweight

beginner.name: Preacher Curl Machine
beginner.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Full bicep isolation without swinging.
steps: Adjust seat height so armpits rest comfortably over the top edge of the angled pad.
Grasp handles with underhand grip and arms fully extended on the pad.
Curl handles upward toward shoulders, squeezing biceps hard at the top.
Lower weights smoothly over 3 seconds until arms are nearly straight.
commonMistakes: Lifting elbows off pad during curl.
Hyperextending elbows abruptly at bottom.

machine.name: Selectorized Preacher Bicep Curl Machine
machine.setupGuide: Seat pin set so chest meets pad comfortably.

beginner.name: Forearm Plank (Standard Hold)
beginner.formCue: Static Hold — Squeeze glutes and brace core as if bracing for a punch.
steps: Place forearms on mat with elbows directly under shoulders.
Extend legs straight behind you, resting on balls of feet.
Tuck pelvis slightly, squeeze glutes, and draw navel toward spine.
Breathe steadily while maintaining a straight line from crown of head to heels.
commonMistakes: Sagging lower back towards floor.
Hiking hips up into an inverted V shape.

machine.name: Stretching Mat & Floor Area
machine.setupGuide: Roll out clean exercise mat.

beginner.name: Dead Bug (Floor Core Stabilization)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Keep lower back pinned firmly against the floor.
steps: Lie on back with arms pointing to ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above hips.
Press your lower back flat into the mat eliminating any gap.
Slowly lower right arm back and left leg forward toward the floor simultaneously.
Return to center and repeat on opposite diagonal side.
commonMistakes: Allowing lower back to arch off the floor.
Rushing the movement without breathing.

machine.name: Cushioned Exercise Mat
machine.setupGuide: Open mat area.

beginner.name: Seated Abdominal Crunch Machine
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Curl spine forward rather than pushing with arms.
steps: Sit in machine and adjust seat so chest pad sits against sternum.
Place feet securely on the footrests or under rollers.
Contract abdominal wall and crunch ribs down toward hips.
Hold contraction for 1 second, then control back to starting upright posture.
commonMistakes: Pulling with arm strength rather than contracting abs.
Over-arching spine on the return.

machine.name: Selectorized Ab Crunch Machine
machine.setupGuide: Pin load to 15kg-20kg to start.

beginner.name: Bird-Dog (Quadruped Core Balance)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Hips level, reach fingers forward and heels back.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach right arm straight forward and left leg straight back until parallel to floor.
Hold for 1 second keeping hips square to the ground.
Return to hands and knees and alternate sides.
commonMistakes: Rotating hips sideways.
Lifting limbs higher than torso height.

machine.name: Floor Exercise Mat
machine.setupGuide: Clear mat area.

beginner.name: Pallof Press (Cable Core Anti-Rotation)
beginner.formCue: Tempo 2-2-2-0 — Resist the cable pull trying to rotate your torso.
steps: Set cable pulley to chest height with a single D-handle.
Stand sideways to cable machine holding handle with both hands at center of chest.
Step out to create tension. Feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Press handle straight out in front of chest, hold for 2s resisting rotation, then return to chest.
commonMistakes: Letting cable twist the torso towards the machine.
Holding breath during the press.

machine.name: Adjustable Cable Pulley Column
machine.setupGuide: Pulley height notch #8 (chest height). D-handle attachment.

beginner.name: Treadmill Incline Walking (Low Impact)
beginner.formCue: Steady State — Upright posture, arm swing rhythm, do not hold side rails.
steps: Step onto treadmill belt and attach safety stop clip to clothing.
Start at 4.0 km/h warm-up speed on flat incline for 2 minutes.
Increase incline to 4-6% and speed to 4.8-5.2 km/h for working interval.
Walk tall with natural arm swings keeping eyes forward on horizon.
commonMistakes: Gripping handrails tightly reducing caloric burn and posture.
Slouching or looking down at feet.

machine.name: Commercial Motorized Treadmill (Life Fitness / Woodway)
machine.setupGuide: Attach safety clip. Select Quick Start or Incline Walk program.

beginner.name: Stationary Recumbent Bike
beginner.formCue: Aerobic Zone 2 — Relaxed back against seat, continuous fluid pedal strokes.
steps: Adjust seat distance so knees maintain slight bend at full pedal extension.
Fasten foot straps over running shoes.
Begin pedaling at a smooth cadence of 75-80 RPM.
Maintain steady aerobic breathing throughout the 15-minute session.
commonMistakes: Seat too close causing knee strain.
Pedaling too slowly with excessively heavy resistance.

machine.name: Recumbent Exercise Bike (Matrix)
machine.setupGuide: Adjust seat slider lever to leg length.

beginner.name: Elliptical Cross Trainer (Zero Impact)
beginner.formCue: Full Body Push-Pull — Drive with legs while pushing and pulling dual handles.
steps: Step onto foot pedals and grasp moving upper handlebars.
Push forward in a smooth gliding oval path.
Distribute effort 60% through legs and 40% through upper body handles.
Keep heels pressed down onto pedals to protect calves.
commonMistakes: Bouncing on toes only.
Leaning all weight onto stationary center handles.

machine.name: Elliptical Trainer (Precor EFX)
machine.setupGuide: Power on console by beginning pedal motion.

beginner.name: Concept2 Rowing Machine (Steady Aerobic Pace)
beginner.formCue: Sequencing: Legs -> Body -> Arms on drive; Arms -> Body -> Legs on recovery.
steps: Fasten foot straps over widest part of shoes. Set damper lever to 3 or 4.
Grasp handle with overhand grip and slide forward to the catch.
Drive powerfully through legs, swing torso back, and pull handle to lower ribs.
Extend arms forward, hinge torso forward, then slide legs back to repeat.
commonMistakes: Pulling with arms before legs have driven.
Setting damper to 10 causing premature muscular fatigue.

machine.name: Concept2 Ergometer Model D
machine.setupGuide: Damper set to 3. PM5 monitor on Just Row.

beginner.name: Low-Impact Step-Touch & Jumping Jacks (Modified)
beginner.formCue: Agility & Heart Rate — Soft knees, step feet out side to side with overhead clap.
steps: Stand with feet together and hands at sides.
Step right foot wide while raising arms overhead.
Return to center, then step left foot wide with overhead reach.
Maintain a quick, upbeat cardiovascular tempo for 45 continuous seconds.
commonMistakes: Stomping heavily on heels.
Holding breath during movement intervals.

machine.name: Aerobic Exercise Flooring
machine.setupGuide: Clear 2x2 meter floor perimeter.

intermediate.name: Barbell Bench Press
intermediate.formCue: Lower bar in a controlled 3-second descent touching lower sternum. Drive upward explosively without flaring elbows.
steps: Lie flat on bench with eyes under barbell. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, arch lower back slightly, and retract scapulae.
Lower bar in a controlled 3-second descent touching lower sternum. Drive upward explosively without flaring elbows.
Breathing: Inhale deeply at the top and hold during descent; exhale forcefully past the sticking point.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows out to 90 degrees
Bouncing the barbell off ribcage
Lifting hips off the bench

intermediate.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
intermediate.formCue: Keep elbows at 45 degrees to torso. Lower until you feel a deep stretch in upper pecs, then drive inward.
steps: Set bench to 30 degrees. Kick dumbbells up to shoulder level with knees, plant feet firmly, and press up over upper chest.
Keep elbows at 45 degrees to torso. Lower until you feel a deep stretch in upper pecs, then drive inward.
Breathing: Inhale on the lowering phase; exhale as you push the dumbbells upward.
commonMistakes: Setting bench angle too high (>45°) which shifts load to shoulders
Touching dumbbells together at top and losing tension

intermediate.name: Chest Fly
intermediate.formCue: Open arms in a wide hugging arc until chest is stretched. Squeeze pecs hard to bring dumbbells back together.
steps: Lie supine holding dumbbells above chest with neutral grip and slight bend in elbows.
Open arms in a wide hugging arc until chest is stretched. Squeeze pecs hard to bring dumbbells back together.
Breathing: Inhale as you open wide into the chest stretch; exhale as you adduct arms back to center.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much and turning it into a press
Going too heavy and hyperextending shoulders

intermediate.name: Dumbbell Pullover
intermediate.formCue: Lower dumbbell behind head in an arc until a deep ribcage stretch is achieved. Pull back over chest focusing on serratus and pecs.
steps: Rest upper back perpendicular across a flat bench, hips slightly lowered. Hold one dumbbell with both hands in diamond grip.
Lower dumbbell behind head in an arc until a deep ribcage stretch is achieved. Pull back over chest focusing on serratus and pecs.
Breathing: Take a deep diaphragmatic breath expanding the ribcage as the weight lowers; exhale as you pull over.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows excessively like a triceps extension
Allowing hips to rise up above bench height

intermediate.name: Push-Ups
intermediate.formCue: Lower chest to 1 inch off the floor with elbows tracking 45 degrees back. Press up to full arm extension.
steps: Place hands shoulder-width apart on floor, feet together, body in rigid plank.
Lower chest to 1 inch off the floor with elbows tracking 45 degrees back. Press up to full arm extension.
Breathing: Inhale descending; exhale driving up while bracing core.
commonMistakes: Sagging lower back or piking hips in the air
Half reps without full chest depth

intermediate.name: Overhead Press
intermediate.formCue: Press bar vertically, tilting head slightly back to clear chin, then pushing head through window at top lockout.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width, bar resting across clavicles. Squeeze glutes and brace core.
Press bar vertically, tilting head slightly back to clear chin, then pushing head through window at top lockout.
Breathing: Inhale and brace core before pressing; exhale once past forehead level.
commonMistakes: Excessive lower back arching
Pressing bar forward instead of vertical
Not locking out at top

intermediate.name: Lateral Raise
intermediate.formCue: Raise arms laterally leading with elbows until parallel to floor. Pour the pitcher slightly with thumbs angled down.
steps: Stand tall with slight forward hinge, dumbbells at thighs with elbows slightly bent.
Raise arms laterally leading with elbows until parallel to floor. Pour the pitcher slightly with thumbs angled down.
Breathing: Exhale as you raise outward; inhale on controlled descent.
commonMistakes: Using torso momentum or swinging
Shrugging traps instead of isolating lateral delts

intermediate.name: Front Raise
intermediate.formCue: Raise dumbbells straight forward to eye level with strict control. Pause for a split second, then lower slowly.
steps: Stand upright holding dumbbells in front of thighs with overhand grip.
Raise dumbbells straight forward to eye level with strict control. Pause for a split second, then lower slowly.
Breathing: Exhale on upward lift; inhale lowering down.
commonMistakes: Swinging hips to launch dumbbells
Raising far above shoulder level

intermediate.name: Rear Delt Fly
intermediate.formCue: Sweep arms out wide and slightly back like wings, squeezing the back of your shoulders at the peak.
steps: Hinge at hips to a 45-degree angle with flat spine and soft knees. Let dumbbells hang below shoulders.
Sweep arms out wide and slightly back like wings, squeezing the back of your shoulders at the peak.
Breathing: Exhale raising wide; inhale returning under control.
commonMistakes: Rounding lower back
Using heavy weights and turning it into a row

intermediate.name: Shrugs
intermediate.formCue: Elevate shoulders straight upward towards your ears. Hold the peak contraction for 1-2 seconds, then lower under control.
steps: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides with neutral grip, arms straight and shoulders back.
Elevate shoulders straight upward towards your ears. Hold the peak contraction for 1-2 seconds, then lower under control.
Breathing: Exhale on shrug elevation; inhale on the eccentric stretch.
commonMistakes: Rolling shoulders in circles (injures rotator cuffs)
Bending elbows to assist lift

intermediate.name: Barbell Curl
intermediate.formCue: Curl bar upward in a smooth arc to upper chest. Squeeze biceps hard at peak, then take 3 seconds to lower.
steps: Stand tall holding barbell with shoulder-width supinated grip, elbows tucked against ribcage.
Curl bar upward in a smooth arc to upper chest. Squeeze biceps hard at peak, then take 3 seconds to lower.
Breathing: Exhale curling upward; inhale lowering down.
commonMistakes: Rocking torso back and forth
Flaring elbows away from sides
Letting bar drop freely

intermediate.name: Dumbbell Curl
intermediate.formCue: Curl up while rotating wrist (supination) so palm faces ceiling by mid-repetition. Squeeze at top.
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms facing each other at bottom position.
Curl up while rotating wrist (supination) so palm faces ceiling by mid-repetition. Squeeze at top.
Breathing: Exhale as you curl and supinate; inhale during descent.
commonMistakes: Swinging shoulders forward to assist
Failing to fully supinate wrist

intermediate.name: Hammer Curl
intermediate.formCue: Curl straight up toward shoulders maintaining neutral palms. Great for widening arm profile and forearms.
steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral grip) throughout entire rep.
Curl straight up toward shoulders maintaining neutral palms. Great for widening arm profile and forearms.
Breathing: Exhale on contraction; inhale on descent.
commonMistakes: Elbows moving forward past ribcage
Using excessive torso sway

intermediate.name: Preacher Curl
intermediate.formCue: Curl bar toward chin without lifting elbows off pad. Lower under strict control to 95% extension.
steps: Sit at preacher bench with upper arms flat against 45-degree pad, gripping inner EZ-bar knurling.
Curl bar toward chin without lifting elbows off pad. Lower under strict control to 95% extension.
Breathing: Exhale curling bar up; inhale as you lower smoothly.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending and locking out elbow violently at bottom
Lifting body off seat

intermediate.name: Concentration Curl
intermediate.formCue: Curl dumbbell up smoothly towards your face, keeping torso steady. Peak squeeze at top for 1 second.
steps: Sit on bench with legs spread. Brace back of elbow against inner thigh of same side.
Curl dumbbell up smoothly towards your face, keeping torso steady. Peak squeeze at top for 1 second.

intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Push hips straight back to wall, intense hamstring stretch.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells or barbell in front of thighs with slight knee bend.
Hinge backward at hips, pushing glutes toward wall behind you.
Keep weights close to shins and lower until hamstrings are fully stretched (mid-shin).
Drive hips forward to return to standing, squeezing glutes at top.
commonMistakes: Rounding lower back into flexion.
Turning movement into a squat by bending knees too much.

machine.name: Free Weight Lifting Platform
machine.setupGuide: Keep flat back posture.

intermediate.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell Loaded)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Rear foot elevated on bench, unilateral quad & glute builder.
steps: Stand 2 feet in front of a flat bench holding dumbbells at your sides.
Place top of right foot laces-down on the bench behind you.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor and back knee nearly touches ground.
Drive through front heel to return to standing.
commonMistakes: Front foot placed too close to bench causing extreme knee shear.
Leaning back excessively instead of maintaining forward torso angle.

machine.name: Flat Utility Bench & Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Bench positioned with clear floor space in front.

intermediate.name: Hack Squat Machine (Plate Loaded)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Full quad depth with complete back support.
steps: Step onto footplate with shoulder-width stance, shoulders under padded rests.
Disengage safety handles and lower carriage smoothly into full knee flexion.
Pause at bottom for 1 second without bouncing.
Press powerfully through whole foot back to near lockout.
commonMistakes: Lifting heels off footplate.
Violently locking knees at top.

machine.name: 45-Degree Incline Hack Squat Machine
machine.setupGuide: Release safety side levers after stepping in.

intermediate.name: Seated Calf Raise (Soleus Focus)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 2-2-1-1 — 2s deep stretch at bottom, 1s hard contraction at peak.
steps: Sit on machine, place balls of feet on foot bar, and adjust thigh pad snugly over knees.
Release safety bar and lower heels down into maximum ankle dorsiflexion.
Hold deep stretch for 2 seconds.
Press high onto balls of feet contracting calves hard for 1 second.
commonMistakes: Bouncing weight with momentum.
Shallow range of motion.

machine.name: Seated Plate-Loaded Calf Machine
machine.setupGuide: Thigh pad locked securely above knee joints.

alternatives.name: Standing Calf Raise on Smith Machine

intermediate.name: EZ-Bar Bicep Curl
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Angled EZ grip reduces wrist torque and allows heavy loading.
steps: Grasp EZ-bar on the inner angled knurling with underhand grip.
Stand tall with elbows pinned against your flanks.
Curl bar upward toward chest, squeezing biceps firmly at top.
Lower bar under control over 2-3 seconds back to arms length.
commonMistakes: Leaning back or swaying torso.
Letting elbows travel forward.

machine.name: Pre-Loaded EZ-Barbell Racks
machine.setupGuide: Select fixed EZ-bar or load plates with collars.

intermediate.name: Skull Crusher (Lying EZ-Bar Tricep Extension)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Lower bar to hairline, keep upper arms angled slightly back.
steps: Lie on flat bench holding EZ-bar with arms extended vertically.
Angle upper arms slightly backwards toward your head (10 degrees).
Bend elbows to lower bar smoothly down toward forehead/hairline.
Extend elbows forcefully to return bar to starting angle.
commonMistakes: Letting elbows flare outward.
Moving entire upper arm instead of pivoting purely at elbow.

machine.name: Flat Utility Bench & EZ-Bar
machine.setupGuide: Bench set flat. Check collars are locked.

alternatives.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
alternatives.swapReason: Deep stretch on long head of triceps

intermediate.name: Incline Dumbbell Bicep Curl
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — 45-degree incline puts long head of bicep under extreme stretch.
steps: Set utility bench to a 45-degree incline and sit back with head on pad.
Let arms hang vertically straight down holding dumbbells.
Curl dumbbells upward while supinating wrists, keeping upper arms hanging straight down.
Squeeze biceps at the top, then lower with control over 3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Swinging arms forward out of the vertical plane.
Rushing through the bottom stretched position.

machine.name: Adjustable Utility Bench (45 degrees) & Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Incline pin in notch #4 (45 degrees).

alternatives.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
alternatives.swapReason: Continuous cable tension in stretched position

intermediate.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension (Rope)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Deep stretch behind head, lock out overhead.
steps: Attach rope to mid-high cable pulley. Face away from machine with split stance.
Hold rope ends behind head with elbows pointing forward and bent.
Extend elbows forward and overhead, separating rope ends at full extension.
Slowly allow forearms to fold back behind head under steady cable tension.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows wide.
Arching lower back under load.

machine.name: Adjustable Cable Column & Braided Rope
machine.setupGuide: Set pulley to chest/shoulder height.

alternatives.name: Seated Overhead Dumbbell Extension
alternatives.swapReason: Free weight long head tricep mass builder

intermediate.name: Cross-Body Dumbbell Hammer Curl
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 2-0-1-0 — Curl across chest toward opposite collarbone.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides in neutral grip.
Curl right dumbbell diagonally across body toward left shoulder.
Squeeze brachioradialis and forearm hard at top.
Lower smoothly back to side and repeat with left arm.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to throw weight across body.
Allowing wrist to bend.

machine.name: Dumbbell Free Weight Area
machine.setupGuide: Select moderate weight dumbbell pair.

intermediate.name: Hanging Leg Raise (Captain’s Chair or Pull-Up Bar)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Roll pelvis upward to engage rectus abdominis.
steps: Mount Captain’s chair resting forearms on pads with back against cushion, or hang from pull-up bar.
Keep legs together and engage core.
Raise knees/legs up toward chest until thighs pass horizontal level.
Lower legs with complete control without swinging.
commonMistakes: Swinging legs with momentum like a pendulum.
Arching lower back on descent.

machine.name: Captain’s Chair / Power Tower
machine.setupGuide: Rest forearms securely on horizontal pads.

intermediate.name: Cable Woodchopper (High-to-Low Oblique Drive)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 2-0-1-0 — Pivot on back foot, drive rotation through core and hips.
steps: Set cable pulley to top height with single D-handle.
Stand sideways to machine, grasp handle with both hands above shoulder.
Pull handle diagonally downward across body toward opposite knee.
Control handle back up to start along the same diagonal path.
commonMistakes: Pulling only with arms instead of rotating through torso.
Keeping feet glued to floor without pivoting.

machine.name: Adjustable Cable Pulley Column
machine.setupGuide: Pulley set to notch #12.

intermediate.name: Ab Roller Wheel Rollout (From Knees)
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-2-0 — Hollow body position, roll wheel forward under strict control.
steps: Kneel on a soft exercise mat holding ab roller handles directly beneath shoulders.
Tuck pelvis into posterior tilt, rounding lower back slightly.
Roll wheel straight forward, extending body as far as you can control without sagging.
Pull through core and lats to roll wheel back to starting position.
commonMistakes: Allowing lower back to hyperextend/dip toward floor.
Pulling hips back with glutes instead of engaging abs.

machine.name: Dual-Wheel Ab Roller on Mat
machine.setupGuide: Place knee mat on smooth level flooring.

alternatives.name: Stability Ball Rollout
alternatives.swapReason: Larger sphere makes rollout more forgiving

intermediate.name: Russian Twists with Medicine Ball / Plate
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 2-0-2-0 — Feet elevated, rotate shoulders fully side to side.
steps: Sit on mat with knees bent, feet elevated 3 inches off the ground.
Lean torso back 45 degrees holding a 5-10kg plate or medicine ball with both hands.
Rotate torso smoothly to the right, tapping weight near hip.
Rotate fully across to the left side in steady control.
commonMistakes: Only moving arms while torso stays rigid.
Rounding back and slouching chest.

machine.name: Medicine Ball / Weight Plate Area
machine.setupGuide: Select 5kg or 8kg rubber medicine ball.

intermediate.name: Decline Bench Weighted Crunch
intermediate.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Increase lever angle on decline bench, curl sternum to pelvis.
steps: Hook feet under leg rollers on decline crunch bench.
Hold weight plate flat against chest.
Lower torso back until shoulders hover just above bench pad.
Contract abdominal wall to curl torso upward to 45 degrees, squeezing at peak.
commonMistakes: Pulling behind neck with hands.
Coming up all the way into hip flexion instead of abdominal crunch.

machine.name: Adjustable Decline Abdominal Bench
machine.setupGuide: Set bench to notch #2 or #3 incline angle.

intermediate.name: Treadmill Incline HIIT Intervals
intermediate.formCue: High Intensity Interval Training — Maximum cardiovascular output during 30s burst.
steps: Warm up 3 minutes at light jog pace (7.5 km/h).
Increase speed to 10.5-12.0 km/h and sprint hard with high knee drive for 30s.
Step onto side rails or reduce speed to 4.5 km/h for 60s active recovery walk.
Repeat for 6 total interval rounds.
commonMistakes: Holding side rails during sprinting intervals.
Skipping the cool-down recovery walk.

machine.name: Commercial Running Treadmill
machine.setupGuide: Set speed preset buttons for fast toggling.

intermediate.name: StairMaster StepMill (Climber Intervals)
intermediate.formCue: Glute & Cardiovascular Engine — Step with full foot on each stair, upright torso.
steps: Step onto revolving steps and press Quick Start.
Set speed level between 7 and 9 (steady challenging climbing cadence).
Keep spine upright without slouching over handrails.
Step firmly through heel and mid-foot on every revolving step.
commonMistakes: Leaning all upper body weight forward onto side handrails.
Stepping only on toes straining Achilles tendon.

machine.name: StairMaster 8-Series StepMill
machine.setupGuide: Start at Level 5 to catch rhythm before ramping up.

intermediate.name: Concept2 Rowing Machine (500m Intervals)
intermediate.formCue: Explosive Leg Drive — Drive violently with legs, crisp arm finish.
steps: Secure feet and set damper to 5.
Execute powerful 500-meter row targeting sub-1:55 split pace.
Rest 90 seconds while breathing deeply.
Repeat for 4 total intervals.
commonMistakes: Shooting the slide (opening hips before legs finish driving).
Rounding shoulders and back at the catch.

machine.name: Concept2 Rowing Ergometer
machine.setupGuide: Set PM5 screen to Interval Distance (500m / 90s rest).

intermediate.name: Jump Rope High-Cadence Double Bounces
intermediate.formCue: Quick Ankle Elasticity — Bounding on balls of feet, wrists turning the cable.
steps: Hold jump rope handles with elbows close to ribs.
Turn rope with small circular wrist motions.
Jump just 1-2 inches off the ground on balls of feet as rope passes under.
Sustain steady rapid rhythm for 60 seconds.
commonMistakes: Jumping too high bending knees excessively.
Using whole arms to swing rope instead of wrists.

machine.name: High-Speed Bearing Jump Rope
machine.setupGuide: Adjust cable length so handles reach armpits when standing on center.

intermediate.name: Kettlebell Swings (Russian Hip Hinge)
intermediate.formCue: Explosive Hip Snap — Power comes from hips and glutes, arms are just ropes.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, kettlebell on floor 1 foot ahead.
Hinge hips, grasp kettlebell, hike it backward between thighs like a football.
Snap hips forward explosively, driving kettlebell up to chest level.
Let bell float, then guide it back into next hip hinge.
commonMistakes: Squatting instead of hinging at hips.
Lifting kettlebell with shoulders and arms.

machine.name: Cast Iron Competition Kettlebell
machine.setupGuide: Ensure 3 meters clear distance ahead.

advanced.name: Heavy Barbell Flat Bench Press (Pause Reps)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-2-X-0 — 3s eccentric descent, 2s motionless chest pause, explosive drive.
steps: Set up under Olympic bar, establish tight upper-back arch and scapular retraction.
Plant feet firmly and squeeze glutes. Unrack bar into stable lockout position.
Lower bar under strict 3-second tempo until touching lower sternum.
Pause dead still on chest for 2 full seconds without losing back tension.
Drive bar violently upward to lockout.
commonMistakes: Losing tightness or letting chest cave during pause.
Bouncing off ribs.

machine.name: Competition Olympic Bench Press (Eleiko)
machine.setupGuide: J-cups set at notch #7. Steel safety catches pinned.

advanced.name: Weighted Chest Dips (Dip Belt Loaded)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Heavy external load, forward torso pitch for lower pec shear.
steps: Fasten leather dip belt around waist with weight plate suspended between legs.
Mount parallel bars, lean torso forward 30 degrees, cross ankles.
Lower body smoothly until shoulders are below elbows at 90 degrees.
Press powerfully back up to lockout, maintaining forward lean throughout.
commonMistakes: Swinging the hanging weight plate.
Hyperextending neck.

machine.name: Heavy-Duty Parallel Bar Rig & Leather Dip Belt
machine.setupGuide: Secure chain with carabiner through center hole of Olympic plate.

advanced.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press (Heavy Compound)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-X-0 — Clavicular pectoral mass builder with 3s eccentric.
steps: Lie on dedicated 30-degree incline Olympic bench station.
Grasp bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Retract shoulder blades.
Lower bar with elbows tucked at 45 degrees to touch upper chest near collarbone.
Drive explosively upward back over eye level.
commonMistakes: Bouncing bar off clavicle.
Flaring elbows out horizontally.

machine.name: Olympic Incline Bench Press Station
machine.setupGuide: Ensure safety catches are pinned.

advanced.name: Plate-Loaded Hammer Strength Incline Press (Drop Set)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-0-1-0 — Heavy top set immediately stripped by 30% for brutal drop set.
steps: Load plate pegs with working weight and drop set plates on outside.
Set seat height so handles match upper pectoral line.
Perform 6-8 heavy repetitions to technical near-failure.
Immediately stand up, strip outer plate, sit back down and complete 6 drop repetitions.
commonMistakes: Resting too long during plate stripping.
Lifting upper back off pad.

machine.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Incline Press
machine.setupGuide: Seat height notch #3. Converging motion path.

advanced.name: Deficit Push-Up to Dumbbell Fly Superset
advanced.formCue: Mechanical Superset — Deep deficit push-up followed immediately by dumbbell fly.
steps: Place two step risers or weight plates on floor; perform 10 deep deficit push-ups with chest sinking past hands.
Immediately transition onto flat bench, grab dumbbells and perform 10 strict chest flyes.
Squeeze chest intensely at completion of each rep.
commonMistakes: Resting between the two movements.
Sacrificing form as fatigue sets in.

machine.name: Flat Bench, Step Blocks & Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Set bench and deficit blocks in close proximity.

advanced.name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
advanced.formCue: Tempo 1-1-X-0 — Pull slack out of bar, wedge hips, push floor away explosively.
steps: Step up to bar with feet hip-width, barbell cutting across mid-foot.
Hinge at hips, grip bar outside shins with hook grip or double overhand with chalk.
Pull chest up, drag bar up against shins, and wedge hips into the bar.
Drive floor away with legs, extending hips and knees simultaneously to strong upright lockout.
commonMistakes: Rounding lumbar spine under heavy pull.
Jerking bar off floor without pulling slack out first.

machine.name: Olympic Deadlift Platform (Oak & Rubber)
machine.setupGuide: Chalk hands at chalk station. Secure spring or lockjaw collars.

alternatives.name: Trap Bar Deadlift (High Handles)
alternatives.swapReason: More upright torso reducing spinal shear

advanced.name: Weighted Pull-Up (Dip Belt Loaded)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Full range from dead hang to chin clearing bar with heavy belt load.
steps: Fasten leather dip belt around waist with Olympic weight plate securely chained.
Grasp pull-up bar with overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Hang with arms fully extended, contract core and drive elbows down toward ribs.
Pull until chin completely clears the bar level. Lower under control.
commonMistakes: Kicking legs forward to swing weight plate up.
Stopping short of full arm extension at bottom.

machine.name: Multi-Grip Chinning Station & Dip Belt
machine.setupGuide: Dip belt chained with 10kg or 20kg plate.

advanced.name: Pendlay Row (Dead Stop From Floor)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 1-1-X-1 — Back parallel to floor, barbell rests on ground between every rep.
steps: Stand over barbell with feet hip-width. Hinge at hips until torso is completely parallel to floor.
Grip bar with overhand grip wider than shoulders.
Explosively row bar from the floor to touch lower sternum without rising up.
Lower bar back to dead stop on the floor before next rep.
commonMistakes: Lifting torso upright during pull.
Bouncing bar off the floor.

machine.name: Olympic Barbell & Bumper Plates on Platform
machine.setupGuide: Use full-diameter bumper plates so bar sits at proper height off floor.

advanced.name: Seal Row (Elevated Bench Chest-Supported)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Zero momentum, pure lat and rhomboid contraction.
steps: Lie face down on elevated high bench with barbell resting directly beneath.
Grasp barbell with overhand grip.
Row bar up to bottom of the bench pad, squeezing upper back intensely at peak.
Lower bar back to arms length under complete control.
commonMistakes: Lifting chest off bench pad.
Dropping bar too fast.

machine.name: Dedicated Seal Row Bench Station
machine.setupGuide: Elevated bench on blocks so arms hang fully extended.

advanced.name: Meadows Row (Landmine Single-Arm Overhand)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Stand perpendicular to landmine bar, pull with overhand flared elbow.
steps: Stand perpendicular to landmine barbell in a staggered stance.
Grip thick end of the bar sleeve with overhand grip using lifting strap.
Rest other arm on knee for balance.
Row elbow up and back, targeting upper lat and rear delt tie-in.
Lower smoothly feeling full lat stretch.
commonMistakes: Standing too upright.
Letting hips twist out of position.

machine.name: Landmine Swivel Attachment & Olympic Bar
machine.gymZone: Zone A / Zone E • Landmine Station
machine.setupGuide: Insert Olympic bar into landmine swivel sleeve. Load 10kg plates for clearance.

advanced.name: Push Press (Barbell Triple Extension)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 1-0-X-1 — Shallow knee dip, explosive leg drive, lock out overhead.
steps: Rack barbell across front shoulders with elbows forward.
Dip knees 2-3 inches in a vertical shallow dip keeping torso upright.
Explode upward through legs, transferring power directly into the overhead press.
Lock out aggressively overhead and hold for 1 second before resetting.
commonMistakes: Dipping too deep into a full squat.
Leaning forward on the dip.

machine.name: Olympic Power Rack Station
machine.setupGuide: J-cups set at armpit height. Secure collars.

alternatives.name: Strict Barbell Overhead Press
alternatives.swapReason: Pure deltoid press without leg drive

advanced.name: Heavy Dumbbell Lateral Raise (Partials & Drop Set)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-1-0 — Full range to failure, continuous partial burn, immediate lighter drop.
steps: Perform 8 strict full-range dumbbell lateral raises.
Without stopping, continue with 6 partial swings from the bottom to mid-thigh.
Drop weights immediately, pick up 50% lighter pair, and pump 8 more full reps to failure.
commonMistakes: Resting between drops.
Shrugging traps excessively.

machine.name: Dumbbell Free Weight Area
machine.setupGuide: Have heavy and light pair ready at your feet.

advanced.name: Behind-The-Neck Barbell Press (Controlled Mobility)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Requires excellent shoulder mobility; lower only to ear level.
steps: Sit on upright bench with bar unracked behind head with wide snatch grip.
Lower bar slowly over 3 seconds only down to ear/upper neck level.
Do not force past comfortable shoulder mobility range.
Press bar straight back up to overhead lockout.
commonMistakes: Dropping bar too low impinging cervical spine.
Using narrow grip.

machine.name: Seated Olympic Shoulder Press Station
machine.setupGuide: Set J-cups to ear level behind head.

alternatives.name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Neck Press
alternatives.swapReason: Fixed guide rails for safe tracking

advanced.name: Barbell Bradford Press (Front-To-Back Flurry)
advanced.formCue: Tempo Continuous — Bar barely clears the crown of head, constant time under tension.
steps: Start with bar resting on front collarbones in standing position.
Press bar upward just high enough to skim over hair, then lower behind head to ear level.
Without pausing, press bar back over top of head to front collarbone.
Front-to-back and back-to-front equals 1 complete repetition.
commonMistakes: Using too heavy weight losing control near the skull.
Locking out arms completely at top.

machine.name: Olympic Barbell Area
machine.setupGuide: Select light barbell to maintain constant tension.

advanced.name: Incline Bench Prone Y-T-W Dumbbell Circuit
advanced.formCue: Rotator Cuff & Lower Trap Circuit — Strict thumbs-up alignment, zero momentum.
steps: Lie face down on 30-degree incline bench with light dumbbells.
Perform 6 raises in a Y-formation (45 degrees forward, thumbs up).
Immediately perform 6 raises straight out in a T-formation.
Finish with 6 W-extensions (elbows bent, external rotation).
Hold each peak for 1 second.
commonMistakes: Using heavy weights that engage upper traps instead of rotator cuff.
Jerking torso off bench.

machine.name: Incline Utility Bench & Light Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Bench set to 30-degree incline.

advanced.name: Pause Barbell Back Squat (2-Second Depth Pause)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-2-X-0 — 3s descent, 2s dead stop at rock bottom, explosive concentric drive.
steps: Unrack heavy barbell across traps, step back into squat stance.
Take deep diaphragmatic breath, brace core 360 degrees.
Descend under control to full deep squat depth below parallel.
Hold completely still in the hole for 2 seconds without bouncing or losing core pressure.
Drive out of the hole explosively through mid-foot.
commonMistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of holding dead stop.
Letting chest collapse during the 2s pause.

machine.name: Heavy Duty Olympic Power Cage
machine.setupGuide: Set heavy safety crossbars at parallel level.

advanced.name: Barbell Front Squat (Clean Grip)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — High elbows parallel to floor, pure vertical quadriceps loading.
steps: Rest bar across anterior deltoids in front rack with fingertips under bar and elbows high.
Unrack bar, set feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat straight down between hips while keeping torso completely vertical.
Hit full depth, drive out of bottom keeping elbows pointing forward.
commonMistakes: Dropping elbows allowing bar to slip down arms.
Rounding upper thoracic spine.

machine.name: Olympic Squat Rack
machine.setupGuide: J-cups set at shoulder height.

alternatives.name: Cross-Arm Front Squat
alternatives.swapReason: For lifters with limited wrist mobility

advanced.name: Deficit Deadlift (1-2 Inch Elevated Platform)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-X-0 — Standing on 2-inch plate increases range of motion and quad off-the-floor drive.
steps: Place a 20kg rubber bumper plate on lifting platform and stand on top of it.
Roll barbell up to shins. Hinge down deeper than normal deadlift setup.
Brace lats and core, pull slack, drive legs through the floor.
Lock out at top, lower bar under control back to platform.
commonMistakes: Rounding back due to the deeper starting deficit.
Dropping bar from top without eccentric control.

machine.name: Deadlift Platform & Bumper Plate Platform
machine.setupGuide: Stand on stable 2-inch rubber plate.

alternatives.name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
alternatives.swapReason: Wide grip increases range of motion

advanced.name: Barbell Walking Lunges (Heavy Overload)
advanced.formCue: Tempo Continuous — Long stride, 90-degree knee angles, explosive push through front heel.
steps: Position barbell comfortably on upper traps in clear turf aisle.
Step forward with long stride, drop back knee until hovering 1 inch off ground.
Drive through front heel to step directly into the next lunge stride with opposite leg.
Keep torso tall and stable throughout the walking sequence.
commonMistakes: Wobbling side to side or taking too short strides.
Banging back knee hard into the floor.

machine.name: Olympic Barbell & Functional Turf Track
machine.setupGuide: Ensure 20-meter turf path is clear of obstacles.

alternatives.name: Heavy Dumbbell Walking Lunges
alternatives.swapReason: Dumbbells at sides lower center of gravity

advanced.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl (Eccentric Control)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 4-0-1-0 — 4-second pure eccentric descent, legendary hamstring injury prevention.
steps: Kneel on soft pad with partner holding ankles or feet locked under heavy padded bar.
Keep hips extended straight in line with torso and thighs.
Slowly lower body forward toward the floor resisting as hard as possible with hamstrings.
Catch yourself on palms in push-up position, push lightly off floor, and use hamstrings to pull back up.
commonMistakes: Bending at hips instead of keeping body in a straight line.
Falling uncontrollably without resisting.

machine.name: Dedicated Nordic Hamstring Bench
machine.gymZone: Zone E • Functional Turf / Hamstring Station
machine.setupGuide: Lock ankle rollers firmly over Achilles.
equipmentChecklist: Nordic curl station or padded bar

advanced.name: Barbell 21s (Bicep Triple-Range Agony)
advanced.formCue: Tempo Continuous — 7 reps bottom-to-halfway, 7 reps halfway-to-top, 7 full range reps.
steps: Stand tall with EZ-bar or barbell in underhand grip.
Perform 7 reps from full extension up to 90 degrees (forearms parallel to floor).
Immediately perform 7 reps from 90 degrees to full peak contraction at shoulders.
Immediately finish with 7 full range-of-motion repetitions to complete the 21-rep cycle.
commonMistakes: Resting between the 7-rep stages.
Swinging hips on the final 7 full reps.

machine.name: EZ-Barbell Area
machine.setupGuide: Select moderate EZ-bar.

alternatives.name: Cable 21s with Straight Bar
alternatives.swapReason: Continuous cable tension throughout all 3 phases

advanced.name: Weighted Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked against ribs for heavy tricep mass.
steps: Lie on flat Olympic bench, grasp bar with hands exactly shoulder-width apart.
Unrack bar, lower smoothly to lower sternum keeping elbows tucked tightly along flanks.
Pause for 1 second on chest.
Press upward explosively through palms, locking out triceps at top.
commonMistakes: Grip too narrow (< 8 inches) which destroys wrists.
Flaring elbows out to sides.

machine.name: Olympic Flat Bench Press Station
machine.setupGuide: J-cups set at arm length. Secure collars.

advanced.name: Incline Dumbbell Spider Curl (Chest on Pad)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-1 — Pure strict short-head bicep isolation; zero body English possible.
steps: Set utility bench to 45-degree incline, lie face down with chest supported over backrest.
Let arms hang vertically toward floor holding dumbbells with underhand grip.
Curl dumbbells up toward forehead, holding peak contraction for 1 full second.
Lower dumbbells with slow control until arms are perpendicular to floor.
commonMistakes: Swinging arms backward like a row.
Lifting chest off pad.

machine.name: Adjustable Utility Bench & Dumbbells
machine.setupGuide: Bench set to 45 degrees.

advanced.name: Overhead French Press (Heavy Seated EZ-Bar)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Full vertical stretch of the long tricep head.
steps: Sit on vertical or low-back utility bench holding EZ-bar overhead.
Keep upper arms close to ears and elbows pointing straight up.
Lower bar behind head by bending elbows until forearms touch biceps.
Press bar forcefully back to overhead extension.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows wide to sides.
Arching lower back off the pad.

machine.name: Low-Back Seated Bench & EZ-Bar
machine.setupGuide: Low-back seat supports lumbar spine.

advanced.name: Cross-Body Incline Hammer Curl + Overhead Tricep Extension Superset
advanced.formCue: Antagonist Superset — Bicep brachialis followed immediately by tricep long head.
steps: Perform 10 heavy cross-body hammer curls targeting forearms and brachialis.
Without resting, raise single dumbbell overhead with both hands and complete 10 overhead extensions.
Rest 90 seconds after completing both movements.
commonMistakes: Resting between bicep and tricep sets.
Dropping elbow position on overhead extensions.

machine.name: Dumbbell Free Weight Area
machine.setupGuide: Have dumbbells ready.

advanced.name: Dragon Flag (Bruce Lee Core Lever)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Only upper shoulder blades touch bench; entire torso and legs remain rigid.
steps: Lie on flat bench, reach hands overhead and grip the edge of the bench beside your ears.
Swing legs and torso up toward vertical, supported only by upper shoulder blades.
Slowly lower straight body toward bench over 3 seconds without bending at hips.
Hover 2 inches above bench, then raise back up to vertical.
commonMistakes: Bending at hips turning movement into a leg raise.
Dropping lower back onto bench.

machine.name: Solid Sturdy Flat Bench
machine.setupGuide: Check bench is firmly anchored.

advanced.name: Toes-To-Bar (Hanging Abdominal Compression)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Strict compression, toes touch bar between hands with zero swing.
steps: Hang from pull-up bar with overhand grip and engaged shoulders.
Without swinging or kipping, compress abdomen and raise toes straight up to tap the bar.
Pause for 1 second at top contact.
Lower legs with controlled resistance back to dead hang.
commonMistakes: Kipping hips to swing toes up.
Dropping legs like a dead weight.

machine.name: Pull-Up Rig / Bar
machine.setupGuide: Chalk hands for firm grip.

advanced.name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout (From Toes)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-2-0 — From standing position; the ultimate anterior core challenge.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width, bend at hips and place ab wheel on floor in front of toes.
Brace core into hollow-body posture and roll wheel forward until nose hovers 1 inch off floor.
Hold extended position for a split second.
Contract core and pull through lats to roll wheel all the way back to standing toes.
commonMistakes: Collapsing stomach to floor.
Hyperextending spine.

machine.name: Ab Roller on Functional Turf
machine.setupGuide: Ensure 3 meters of smooth turf.

advanced.name: Heavy Kneeling Cable Crunch (Rope Attachment)
advanced.formCue: Tempo 3-1-1-0 — Kneel facing machine, curl elbows toward thighs, spine flexion.
steps: Attach rope to high pulley, kneel 2 feet away with hands holding rope ends beside ears.
Fix hip position and curl spine downward, driving elbows toward top of thighs.
Squeeze abs intensely for 1 second at peak contraction.
Rise slowly over 3 seconds under heavy stack tension.
commonMistakes: Sitting hips back onto heels (hip hinge instead of ab crunch).
Pulling with arms rather than crunching torso.

machine.name: High Pulley Cable Column & Rope
machine.setupGuide: Pulley set to top notch #12. Knee mat on floor.

advanced.name: Barbell Landmine 180 Rotations
advanced.formCue: Tempo 2-1-2-0 — Rotational core strength and anti-rotational deceleration.
steps: Hold end of landmine barbell with both hands directly out in front of chest at eye level.
Rotate bar down to right hip in smooth arc keeping arms mostly straight and pivoting back foot.
Drive bar explosively back to center, then rotate down to left hip.
Maintain rock-solid core brace throughout the 180-degree rainbow arc.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows excessively.
Letting weight pull spine into uncontrolled twist.

machine.name: Landmine Swivel Attachment & Olympic Barbell
machine.setupGuide: Insert bar into floor swivel base. Load 10kg or 15kg plate.

advanced.name: Assault AirBike Tabata Protocol (20s All-Out / 10s Rest)
advanced.formCue: Maximum Anaerobic Capacity — Full 4-minute Tabata death sprint (8 rounds).
steps: Adjust AirBike seat height so leg has slight knee bend at bottom.
Start console Tabata program (20s work / 10s rest x 8 rounds).
Sprint with 100% all-out effort pumping arms and driving legs for 20s.
Coast for 10s, then repeat for 8 brutal rounds.
commonMistakes: Pacing yourself; Tabata requires genuine maximal output.
Letting head drop down in fatigue.

machine.name: Assault AirBike Classic / Rogue Echo Bike
machine.setupGuide: Set seat pin. Select Tabata preset on monitor.

advanced.name: Curved Manual Treadmill Sprints (Woodway Curve)
advanced.formCue: True Sprint Mechanics — Self-powered curved slat belt demands aggressive hip flexion.
steps: Step onto curved manual slat treadmill.
Sprint forward, driving balls of feet into the upward curve to accelerate the belt.
Reach top sprint velocity for 20 seconds.
Step feet onto side rails and walk off for 40 seconds recovery.
commonMistakes: Looking down causing tripping.
Stomping flat-footed on curved slats.

machine.name: Woodway Curve / AssaultRunner Non-Motorized Treadmill
machine.setupGuide: No power switch; belt is 100% human-powered.

advanced.name: Heavy Sled / Prowler Push (Turf 25-Meter Drive)
advanced.formCue: Unstoppable Leg Drive — 45-degree body lean, arms locked, piston leg drives.
steps: Load Olympic plates onto steel turf sled.
Grasp vertical upright poles with arms extended and torso at a 45-degree angle.
Drive powerfully into the turf, taking deep marching sprint steps for 25 meters.
Turn around and push back to start.
commonMistakes: Bending arms allowing chest to collapse into poles.
Taking tiny stutter steps.

machine.name: Heavy Duty Steel Prowler / Push Sled
machine.setupGuide: Load bumper plates evenly on center vertical post.

alternatives.name: Farmer’s Walk with Heavy Trap Bar

advanced.name: Double-Under Jump Rope Intervals
advanced.formCue: Double Rotation per Jump — Rope spins twice under feet on every single jump.
steps: Hold speed rope with wrists forward and elbows tucked.
Jump straight up on balls of feet with upright spine.
Flick wrists rapidly twice in mid-air so rope passes under feet twice before landing.
Maintain steady rhythmic bounds through 50 unbroken reps.
commonMistakes: Donkey kicking feet backward.
Piking legs forward in a tuck.

machine.name: Speed Wire Jump Rope
machine.setupGuide: Clear 3x3 meter zone on rubber flooring.

advanced.name: Battle Ropes Alternating Waves to Slam Finisher
advanced.formCue: Upper Body Anaerobic Firestorm — Quarter squat, whip rope rapidly into floor.
steps: Grip thick rope ends with thumbs toward anchor point, feet shoulder-width, athletic quarter squat.
Pump arms alternately up and down as fast as possible creating fluid waves to anchor for 30s.
Immediately raise both arms together overhead and slam ropes violently into floor for 15s.
Rest 60 seconds.
commonMistakes: Standing straight up losing leg and hip base.
Letting rope go slack by standing too close to anchor.

machine.name: 50-Foot Heavy Battle Ropes & Ground Anchor
machine.setupGuide: Take 2 steps forward from anchor to allow wave amplitude.
